data.name: Aarohi
data.gender_notes: Aarohi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ā, 'towards', + ruh, 'to ascend' — 'ascending'; also the ascending scale in Indian music. Its root is Sanskrit ā + ruh. A term in Indian classical music. Aarohi is a Sanskrit name meaning “Ascending; a musical scale”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aarohi expresses “Ascending; a musical scale”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit ā, 'towards', + ruh, 'to ascend' — 'ascending'; also the ascending scale in Indian music.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aarohi total 34, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
